name: com.scryingstone.stellar-sdk
description:
The Stellar Development Toolkit for Unity connects your game or application to the Stellar network and Soroban smart contracts, entirely from C#. It includes a complete JSON-RPC client for Soroban RPC — health checks, ledgers, network info, fee statistics, ledger entries, transactions, and events — plus full XDR serialization and deserialization for Stellar and Soroban data types. Build transactions, simulate and invoke contract functions, and sign locally with Ed25519 keypairs, all through a simple async API that returns explicit success-or-error results.

The toolkit is designed for Unity from the ground up: no external processes or native binaries, just managed C# that works in the editor and in builds, including WebGL and IL2CPP (a bundled link.xml handles code-stripping automatically, with no extra configuration). Its only dependency, Newtonsoft.Json, is resolved automatically through the Package Manager. Connect to testnet or mainnet with a single configuration struct, and get started quickly with the included documentation and a complete runnable sample project.
